items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-11-17
items.q: We used to play with the same band, Gus Muscat.

ctx.x: Let's see. Ask him if he ever knew Lewis Dumain.

Did you know Lewis Dumain? Know who? Dumain. Oh, he's a baby Lewis Dumain. He's a professor, I mean a good reader. He couldn't jazz. He used to like to jazz but he could play nothing new and he could take a violin for it. Turn it upside down and play it all and put it in his keys. He could write through the range. He used to help me out a whole lot too with music. August Ruchel, that is a trambon player. When was he with Dumain? When was he with Dumaine? When was you with Dumaine?
